'''Wesessa''' was a large island on the planet of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It was located in the [[Wesessa Sea/Legends|Wesessa Sea]], east of the [[An'yettu Islands/Legends|An'yettu Islands]] and north of the continent of [[Betu/Legends|Betu]].
